Dear Sir/Madam, 
 
Sub: Audio Recording of Earnings Call in relation to the unaudited standalone and consolidated 
financial results of the HDFC Bank Limited (“the Bank”) for the quarter and half-year ended 
September 30, 2026 
 
In continuation to our intimation dated October 17, 2026 and pursuant to Regulations 30 and 46 of the SEBI 
(Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015, this is to inform you that the audio 
recording of the earnings call with analysts and investors held on October 17, 2026, in relation to the 
unaudited standalone and consolidated financial results of the Bank for the quarter and half-year ended 
September 30, 2026, has been made available on the website of the Bank at the link: 
 
https://www.hdfc.bank.in/about-us/investor-relations 
 
This is for your information and appropriate dissemination. 
 
Thank you. 
 
Yours faithfully, 
For HDFC Bank Limited 
 
 
Ajay Agarwal 
Company Secretary
